summary.en: Pass array storage with its length, preserve row types, and choose safe result storage.
summary.bn: অ্যারের সঙ্গে দৈর্ঘ্য পাঠাও, কলামের টাইপ ঠিক রাখো আর ফল রাখার নিরাপদ জায়গা বেছে নাও।

notes: C17 adjusts array parameters to pointer types; variable row-width interfaces additionally need VLA support.

sections.title: Give a helper both storage and a range
Array notation in a parameter is adjusted
Keep length calculations in the caller
Read, update and fill caller results
Two-dimensional arrays need a row type
Choose where returned data will live
Do not make a length promise that the type cannot enforce
Make input and output roles explicit
Parameter adjustment remains part of C
Pass enough information to use the elements safely

examples.title: Sum through a read-only parameter
examples.explanationHtml: The caller calculates three elements before the call. The helper uses the supplied length and returns 45.

examples.title: Modify elements through an array parameter
examples.explanationHtml: The values become 4, 8 and 12 in the original array. The helper received a copied pointer to those elements.

examples.title: Keep the column count in a matrix parameter
examples.explanationHtml: The row type contains three ints. Advancing a row therefore skips three elements and the result is 21.

examples.title: Write several results into caller storage
examples.explanationHtml: The output array contains 3, 8, 10 and 14. Its lifetime belongs to main, so the values remain valid after return.

examples.title: A static result survives but is reused
examples.explanationHtml: The first line is 4 5. The next call overwrites the same static array, so first now also observes 9.

practice.title: Return a sum through a scalar result
practice.statementHtml: Supply a used count n (0 to 20), followed by n integer elements between -100 and 100. Print Count and values: then the result of a const array sum helper that takes n separately.
hints: An empty range can have sum zero without reading values[0].

practice.title: Produce prefix sums in a second array
practice.statementHtml: Supply a used count n (0 to 20), followed by n integer elements between -100 and 100. Print Count and values: then prefix sums separated by spaces and a newline. Allocate output in main and fill it through a helper.
hints: Keep a running sum and write one output per input.

practice.title: Filter into caller-owned storage
practice.statementHtml: Supply a used count n (0 to 20), followed by n integer elements between -100 and 100. Print Count and values: then the nonnegative values in original order. A helper writes the output and returns its used length.
hints: The destination has capacity 20, so it can hold every retained element.

practice.title: Calculate fixed-width row totals
practice.statementHtml: Read exactly six ints from -100 to 100 for a 2 by 3 matrix. Print Matrix entries: then one sum per row. Use a helper with parameter int matrix[][3] and a separate row count.
hints: Place the known column width in the parameter declaration.

quiz.prompt: What does an int values[] parameter become in a function declaration?
options: A count inferred from the caller
quiz.explanation: C adjusts an array parameter to pointer type; the caller supplies element storage separately.

quiz.prompt: Why pass count separately to array_sum?
options: Every pointer always points to one element only
The pointer does not retain the array length
The compiler requires every helper to have two parameters
quiz.explanation: A valid start pointer alone does not describe the number of available elements.

quiz.prompt: A helper doubles the shared elements. Which caller value is printed afterward?
quiz.explanation: The copied pointer selects original elements, so the second element becomes fourteen.

quiz.prompt: What does sizeof values measure inside a helper whose parameter is int values[]?
options: The caller's complete array byte size
quiz.explanation: Parameter adjustment means values has pointer type inside the function.

quiz.prompt: Which parameter matches rows of exactly three ints?
quiz.explanation: The array parameter adjusts to a pointer to a three-int row, preserving physical row width.

quiz.prompt: The const sum helper sees an empty logical range. Which value is returned?
quiz.explanation: The loop does not read the first reserved element and returns its zero identity.

quiz.prompt: Can a C function return an array type directly?
options: Only if it has no parameters
Only if the array has four elements
quiz.explanation: C can return a pointer or a structure containing an array, but not an array type directly.

quiz.prompt: Why is a caller-owned destination useful for several results?
options: Its lifetime and capacity can be controlled by the caller
It makes input arrays immutable everywhere
It never needs a length contract
quiz.explanation: The helper fills live caller storage under an explicit capacity agreement.

quiz.prompt: A second call reuses static pair storage. What does the saved first pointer observe?
quiz.explanation: Both calls return the same array storage, and the second call replaces its first value with eight.

quiz.prompt: What is the main limitation of returning a static result array pointer?
options: Later calls may overwrite the same shared result
quiz.explanation: Static duration preserves lifetime but does not create separate results per call.

quiz.prompt: Does writing values[20] in a parameter automatically validate a twenty-element caller array?
quiz.explanation: The adjusted parameter is still a pointer. A written bound is not an automatic runtime check.

quiz.prompt: What should a filter helper return when writing a variable number of retained elements?
options: The destination address converted to int
A fixed value independent of retained elements
quiz.explanation: The caller needs to know which destination entries were actually filled.

keyPoints.en: A one-dimensional array argument usually becomes a pointer to its first element.
keyPoints.bn: এক মাত্রার অ্যারে আর্গুমেন্ট সাধারণত প্রথম উপাদানের পয়েন্টার হয়।

keyPoints.en: An array parameter does not carry the array length.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যারে প্যারামিটারের সঙ্গে দৈর্ঘ্য নিজে থেকে যায় না।

keyPoints.en: const on the element type prevents writes through that parameter.
keyPoints.bn: উপাদানের টাইপে const দিলে সেই প্যারামিটার দিয়ে মান বদলানো যায় না।

keyPoints.en: A two-dimensional parameter needs the row width to locate later rows.
keyPoints.bn: দুই মাত্রার প্যারামিটারে পরের সারি খুঁজতে কলামসংখ্যা লাগে।

keyPoints.en: C functions cannot return an array type directly.
keyPoints.bn: C ফাংশন সরাসরি অ্যারে টাইপ রিটার্ন করতে পারে না।

keyPoints.en: Caller-owned output arrays avoid returning expired local storage.
keyPoints.bn: কলারের আউটপুট অ্যারে ব্যবহার করলে মেয়াদ শেষ হওয়া লোকাল মেমরি ফেরাতে হয় না।

examQuestions.question: Why must an array helper receive a length, and why is returning an automatic local array pointer unsafe?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The parameter adjusts to a pointer and does not retain the caller array length. sizeof the parameter measures that pointer. A local automatic array ends its lifetime on return, so its address cannot provide live later result storage. Use caller-owned output, appropriate static storage or an explicitly owned allocation.

#include <stdio.h>

void double_values(int values[], int count)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        values[i] *= 2;
    }
}

int main(void)
{
    int a[] = {3, 7};
    double_values(a, 2);
    printf("%d\n", a[1]);
    return 0;
}

14

The copied pointer selects original elements, so the second element becomes fourteen.

examQuestions.question: Read exactly six ints from -100 to 100 for a 2 by 3 matrix. Print Matrix entries: then one sum per row. Use a helper with parameter int matrix[][3] and a separate row count.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

void print_totals(int matrix[][3], int rows)
{
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            sum += matrix[r][c];
        }
        printf("%d\n", sum);
    }
}

int main(void)
{
    int matrix[2][3];
    puts("Matrix entries:");
    for (int r = 0; r < 2; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            if (scanf("%d", &matrix[r][c]) != 1 ||
                matrix[r][c] < -100 || matrix[r][c] > 100) {
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }
    print_totals(matrix, 2);
    return 0;
}

Place the known column width in the parameter declaration.

For input 0 0 0 0 0 0, the program prints:

Matrix entries:
0
0
